papers.title: Inference after coding agents
papers.abstract: Empirical research is changing rapidly as AI coding agents are becoming increasingly proficient in every step of it, from writing code to manipulating data. We argue that while the potential of coding agents for science is vast, their use in hypothesis testing poses a substantial threat to classical inference, as these agents enable a supercharged form of selective inference. In particular, we argue that coding agents carrying out empirical research introduce a new type of post-selection inference that combines human-like, open-ended search over an implicit space of estimators with programmatic replayability of both the selection and the estimation process. Indeed, we find that on simulated data with zero effects, four frontier agents report significant p-values between 54% and 98% of the time when asked to produce a compelling finding. We propose a simple procedure for detecting and correcting these distortions. After an agent has completed its analysis, we reset and replay it on subsamples of the data to estimate the agent's relative probability of selecting that analysis when it looks statistically favorable. For agents with stable selection behavior, the resulting corrected test is asymptotically valid and consistent conditional on selection. Importantly, the correction is learned from the black-box agent's actual choices rather than a model of how it searches, so it remains valid even as AI technology continues to evolve rapidly. In simulations, the correction robustly lowers the high false rejection rates to near the nominal 5%. We illustrate the method on applications from two published papers.

papers.title: Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
papers.abstract: Coding agents often continue working after their own tests pass. Does this additional work improve the patch, and how much could be saved by stopping earlier? We study these questions through anytime evaluation: replaying recorded runs, scoring intermediate patches with hidden tests, and measuring the cost incurred at each step. For policies that only stop a run or select an earlier patch, this allows paired comparisons without generating new trajectories, provided replay preserves the relevant states. Across about 6,000 runs of eight open models in two scaffolds on SWE-bench Verified, we find substantial differences in the value of continued work. The hindsight saving available at passing self-tests ranges from under 1% to 57%, depending on the model and scaffold. A rule that stops after the same patch passes twice saves 23% in a preregistered replication, but the preregistered quality test does not establish non-inferiority. We explain these differences by measuring how often a rule fires, how often the patch changes afterwards, and whether those changes repair or break it. Fine-tuning agents to imitate the rule saves 30% over six seeds, while quality preservation remains uncertain. Our results help identify both the opportunities and the risks of early stopping.
papers.llm_reason: 把 coding agent 的'何时停'做成 anytime evaluation：重放已录制轨迹、用隐藏测试给中间 patch 打分，从而在不生成新轨迹的前提下做成对比较。规模扎实（约 6000 次运行、8 个开源模型、2 种 scaffold、SWE-bench Verified），并给出可行动结论——自测通过后继续工作的节省空间在 <1% 到 57% 之间，'同一 patch 通过两次就停'的规则在预注册复现实验里省 23%，但预注册的质量检验并未确立非劣性；模仿该规则微调后 6 个种子省 30%，质量保持仍不确定。证据强度中等偏上：有预注册、有多种子、作者主动标注了负面结论（non-inferiority 未成立），这一点比常见的只报正面数字更可信。但摘要未给出可核验的代码仓库或数据入口，'隐藏测试'的构造细节无法从外部核验，因此暂不列为立即可用资产。

papers.title: Surfacing Disagreement Beats Resolving It: A Gated Ablation Study of Provenance-Weighted Memory for Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract: Shared memory for multi-agent debate is usually built to resolve inconsistency: retrieval returns one winning fact and the disagreement disappears before any agent sees it. We ask whether that is correct. In DebateGraph, four backends share one contract (read/write/snapshot), so five mechanisms from the agent-memory literature can be removed independently under a fixed budget, each gated on a pre-declared threshold. Across 39 runs one survives: preserving contradictions and passing the ranked conflict set to the debate, rather than collapsing it to a winner, improves F1 by +0.340 (95% CI [+0.267, +0.414]) and cuts attack success from 22 to 7 of 122 poisoned items (McNemar exact p=0.0003), at equal cost. Reaching it meant fixing a bottleneck in our harness: conflict sets are built only over retrieved edges, and our pre-declared cap left three quarters of planted contradictions unretrievable, first measuring the mechanism at +0.084. The effect replicates on two retrieval substrates and directionally on HotpotQA documents. No other mechanism survives, and two are worse than inert: once contradictions reach the prompt, a write trust-gate and the router's provenance features each cost accuracy (-0.075 and -0.096 F1). The gate fails structurally: poisoned objects are always entities the graph already contains, against 53% of gold, so groundedness scores the lie above a truthful first mention. We release the harness, attack set, and logs, and argue that silently reconciling memory is the assumption worth abandoning.
papers.llm_reason: 多 agent 辩论的记忆层里，'保留矛盾而不是折叠成一个胜者'反而更好：把排序后的冲突集原样交给辩论，F1 +0.340（95% CI [+0.267, +0.414]），122 个被投毒条目中攻击成功率从 22 降到 7（McNemar 精确检验 p=0.0003），且成本不变。方法学最扎实的一点是它按预声明阈值做门控消融（39 次运行），并且如实报告了两个机制比什么都不做更差（写信任门 -0.075 F1、router 来源特征 -0.096 F1），以及一个结构性失败原因（被投毒对象总是图里已有的实体，对照真实答案 53%，所以 groundedness 反而给谎言打高分）。工程上它揭示了一个可操作的陷阱：我们的多 agent 系统默认会'消解矛盾'，这可能正是掩盖投毒的机制。局限：其仓库 ziakhan1516/Debat-Agent-NeurIPS-2026 实测可达且 README 含 DebateGraph 描述，但 README 未出现本文的 arXiv 编号 2611.22461，'该仓库即本文实现'这一绑定只能算部分支持。

papers.title: LMMR: Learned Multigranular Memory Retrieval for Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: Small language model agents have limited space to read the memory needed for multi-hop questions. Relevant facts are often scattered across records whose surrounding text consumes much of that space. We propose LMMR, a learned multigranular memory retrieval method that selects both the next source and how much of it to read. LMMR links paragraphs and sentence fragments to their original sources and pairs views that supply the same missing support during training. Relevant distractors and repeated information provide contrasting examples. At inference, the reranker scores what each candidate adds to an anchor passage, and a selector chooses the evidence within a token budget. On 22,398 official validation questions from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue, a frozen 2B answer model reaches 61.47, 43.26, and 30.58 F1 under a 400-token budget. The gains over query expansion are 3.06, 2.14, and 4.55 points, while memory input decreases by 23.1-26.9%. LMMR also uses 23.5-27.7% fewer input tokens than a coarse retriever trained on the same questions. Against that retriever followed by LLMLingua-2 at comparable input lengths, F1 gains reach 3.99 points and are significant on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA after Holm correction. All eight small answer models evaluated on HotpotQA improve over query expansion and MMR in both F1 and exact match.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 11 figures. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/sungkites/LMMR

papers.title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
papers.abstract: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.
papers.llm_reason: 预测类 agent 的评测基准，方法上有一个真正重要的设计：把证据采集与推理解耦——每两天记录四个商用 web search API 对公开预测市场问题的返回，结果揭晓后离线重放冻结证据，从而在固定证据获取策略下比较模型、记忆策略和搜索源。首版 150 题、614 个证据状态、13.1 万条搜索结果。摘要给出两个诊断性结论：结算后重跑同样查询，对高达 92% 的问题结果会直接说出答案（说明日期过滤不可靠，回溯式评测会泄漏未来信息）；在冻结证据上所有被测 LLM 的预测准确率都不如市场；切换搜索 API 使某模型 Brier 分数变化最多 0.043，大于模型之间的差距。对我们的实际意义很直接——做 agent 评测时，'检索源'可能比'模型'更能决定结论，但摘要未提供可核验的仓库或数据入口，且依赖 4 个商用搜索 API，复现成本较高。

papers.title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
papers.abstract: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.
papers.llm_reason: 把 Schwartz 价值理论中的四类高层价值观写进自改进 coding agent 的持久指令文件，观察的不只是分数，还有'agent 造出什么'（解法的规模、复杂度与路径都随价值取向改变）。结论有反直觉成分：开放性价值提升留出集表现，保守性价值反而低于完全不设价值；让 agent 自己改价值会抹平差异；从 AI 文献里蒸馏出的价值则无可检测增益。观点新、且是少见地把'怎么做事'而非'做成什么'作为研究对象的论文。但证据基础是单篇摘要里的定性描述，'across diverse coding tasks' 的任务集、样本量、显著性都没有给出，无法判断效应量是否稳健；也未找到对应仓库。长尾价值在于它把 agent 指令设计从'写好目标'扩展到'写好取向'，这个视角值得存档。

papers.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.
papers.llm_reason: 跨组织 agent 的身份/信任/证明架构：基于 PKI + 零信任 + 远程证明，用对等组织 CA（AgentCA）替代共享根，先校验证书再验证模型、工具与系统提示词配置，用三项策略检查做授权，实现为不改动底层模型的外置安全层。宣称用 WIMSE 工作负载令牌格式与实体证明令牌（EAT）。摘要给出 8 组织联邦、6 种框架、每组 5 agent 的模拟评测，14 个攻击场景 + 6 个良性任务 × 5 种攻击变体 × 3 次重复，开启全部机制后攻击遏制率从 43% 升到 84%，每请求额外开销约 174 微秒。仓库 CalPolyPomonaCS/Agent-Trust-Infrastructure-ATI-Official 实测可达，README 确有 attestation、WIMSE 等描述，与摘要一致；但评测全部在模拟环境、由 judge 模型打分，没有真实生产部署证据，'open-source package' 的完整度也未核验。架构思路对我们做跨组织 agent 协作有参考价值。

papers.title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.
papers.comment: 12 pages; supplementary material included as ancillary files

papers.title: LMLineage: Content Lineage and Context Governance for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Interpretability for AI agents should not be confined to understanding the model's internal weights. It must also cover the agent's reasoning and decision-making process over multi-source context. We present LMLineage, an out-of-band system that attributes every output sentence of an agent session to its supporting input spans with calibrated confidences, without requiring white-box access to the model or any additional inference passes. On top of the lineage metadata, we build concept-drift micro compaction: instead of waiting for the context-length limit and summarizing everything, the system detects when previously used input documents have stopped being referenced ("drifted") and surgically compacts only those, preserving user instructions verbatim. We evaluate on a multi-tier corpus: 71 gold annotated sentences from 10 Chinese web-QA cases, plus 90 turns of independently collected multi-turn sessions across three generator models (gpt-4o-mini, qwen3.8-27b, deepseek-v4-flash). Results show that (i) window-level embedding similarity is far better aligned with LLM paraphrasing than whole document or lexical matching; (ii) the greedy-window fast path is both faster and more accurate on average than exhaustive line-matching (a multiple-comparisons bias in the latter inflates web recall at the cost of overall accuracy); (iii) per-turn attribution completes in 1s on a single GPU, remaining stable as context accumulates to 40 turns; and (iv) concept-drift detection is conservative (0% false compaction) with recall bounded by attribution accuracy. We further describe the concept-drift micro compaction design and an interactive incident-tracing/memory-cleaning case study. A companion patent application covers the lineage construction method.

papers.title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
papers.abstract: Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability. Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI
papers.llm_reason: RAG 修复过程的审计层：把每次'要不要修、修成什么样'的决策都记进轨迹，再审计轨迹完整性、校验是否作用在正确的候选上、接受规则能触达哪些答案。摘要有两个对工程有用的事实：聚合指标掩盖了失败模式，审计层暴露出'修复接受代价 vs 回归'以及高达 77% 和 76% 的'可用但未实现的修复'缺口；修订后的 harness 在开发集与复现集上分别比 BM25 基线高 3.6 和 3.7 分，甚至超过了'全文可见'的参考分（+1.1 / +2.4），后者是个不太常见但可信的对照。局限：语料是 ContractNLI 非披露协议，领域极窄；只测两个 reader 模型；未找到对应仓库。'可用但未实现修复'这个度量本身值得借鉴。

papers.title: PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. On PhysAlign, PhysScope achieves higher solving scores than direct solving across all six evaluated VLMs. With Gemini-3.8-flash, it outperforms Canvas-CoT by 9.34 percentage points and substantially improves solving accuracy on the out-of-distribution (OOD) PhysUniBench benchmark. Ablation studies support explicit scope management and dependency maintenance as design principles for multimodal physics reasoning agents.
papers.llm_reason: 物理推理里的'前提越界'问题——VLM 能读懂物理图示，却把只在特定状态/条件下成立的约束搬到别处，于是前提错误沿着计算链传播。PhysScope 在推理期加视觉护栏，把物理 scope 绑定到具体视觉观察，显式构造派生视图，修订时对照来源与 scope 检查，被接受的修订会作废已登记的依赖项，从而维持 scope 感知的working memory。摘要给出在 PhysAlign 上对全部六个 VLM 都有提升，相对 Canvas-CoT 在 Gemini-3.8-flash 上高 9.34 分，并在 OOD 的 PhysUniBench 上明显改善，另有消融支持'显式 scope 管理 + 依赖维护'两条设计原则。'被接受的修订作废依赖项'这条工程做法有直接启发。局限：无仓库、无数据入口，+9.34 分是相对单一基线在单一模型上的差值，缺少方差与显著性信息。

papers.title: MIPR: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval with Multi-Category Solutions
papers.abstract: Real-world e-commerce queries often express user intent without naming a target product, and a single intent may be fulfilled by products from multiple categories. However, existing multimodal retrieval benchmarks typically assume a relatively well-defined target, leaving retrieval for intents with multi-category solutions less explored. To fill this gap, we introduce MIPR, a benchmark for Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval comprising 3,522 multimodal queries and a shared corpus of 30,731 products. MIPR features reasoning-intensive retrieval, multi-category solutions, and fine-grained relevance labels. Experiments show that the best embedding-based retriever achieves 49.23% nDCG@10 on the full query set, and 55.86% solution-category recall@10 on queries with multiple solution categories. Reranking improves these scores to 60.11% and 67.00%, respectively, yet substantial gaps to the candidate-pool oracle remain. These results establish MIPR as a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating multimodal intent-to-product retrieval. The data and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/leequeue/MIPR.
papers.llm_reason: MIPR 意图到商品的多模态检索基准：3522 条多模态查询、30731 件商品语料，特点是推理密集、一个意图可由多个品类商品满足、带细粒度相关性标注。最好embedding 检索器 nDCG@10 仅 49.23%，多解品类问题的 solution-category recall@10 为 55.86%，加 rerank 后升到 60.11% 与 67.00%，但与候选池 oracle 仍有明显差距。对做电商检索的团队有参考价值：它量化了'一个意图多品类解'这一场景的检索难度。但我们无电商检索业务，评测数据在 huggingface.co/datasets/leequeue/MIPR，本环境到 huggingface.co 的连接反复超时/被拒，无法确认该数据集是否存在及其内容，因此其可用性标记为待核验。

papers.title: Reliable Evaluation of AI Agents for Investment Research: A Framework for Performance and Validity Assessment
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of evaluating AI agents undertaking investment-research tasks, where agents interact with external information sources and computational tools to produce financial analyses and research reports. An important challenge is that the quality of an agent's final output does not necessarily reflect the quality of its execution process, while the reliability of the resulting assessment also depends on the validity of the evaluation procedure. Furthermore, investment-research tasks differ considerably in their requirements for numerical accuracy, information retrieval, financial analysis and supporting evidence, making it difficult to assess agent performance using a uniform set of criteria. We propose a domain-oriented evaluation framework that distinguishes outcome quality from execution quality and accommodates these differences through task-specific criteria, deterministic validators and independent large language model judges. We also introduce an evaluation-validity mechanism that examines the integrity of evaluation inputs, reference information, supporting evidence and grading outputs, with expert review used to resolve identified deficiencies and significant grading disagreements. Numerical results show that the proposed framework can distinguish differences in agent performance across evaluation dimensions, while identifying potential reliability issues in the evaluation process. The associated implementation and evaluation materials will be made available on GitHub.
papers.llm_reason: 投研 agent 的评测框架，区分结果质量与执行质量，并用确定性校验器 + 独立 judge 模型 + 专家复核来兜住评测有效性。方向合理，但摘要只给出定性结论（'数值结果显示框架能区分不同维度的表现，并识别出评测过程中的可靠性问题'），没有给出任何具体数值、基准规模或数据集；代码仅承诺'will be made available on GitHub'，检索 GitHub 未找到对应仓库。同批中 ForecastGym 在'评测设计'这一维度上给出了更硬的具体数字，优先级更高。金融投研场景与我们当前方向也不重合。

papers.title: JET: Just-Enough Exploration Tuning for Efficient Tool-Calling Agents in Repository-Level Question Answering
papers.abstract: In repository-level question answering (QA), an agent explores a code repository with tools and should answer a question once enough information is gathered. Nevertheless, we find that LLM agents often continue to invoke tools even after the gathered information is already sufficient to answer. We call this phenomenon over-exploration. Moreover, even though existing methods improve task performance through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories, SFT also propagates the over-exploration in the trajectories to the agent. To mitigate over-exploration, we propose Just-Enough Exploration Tuning (JET), a fine-tuning method that trains the agent to answer once the gathered information is sufficient. JET truncates each training trajectory at the step where the gathered information becomes sufficient, inserts a rationale that explains why the agent can answer at that step, and fine-tunes the agent with a higher loss weight on the rationale. Experiments on two repository-level QA benchmarks with two open-weight 8B models demonstrate that JET reduces tool calls by 11 to 33% on self-generated trajectories while largely preserving the score. On expert trajectories, JET makes 18 to 28% fewer tool calls than SFT while retaining most of the score gain of SFT. In both cases, JET also lowers the inference cost.
papers.llm_reason: 仓库级 QA 的'过度探索'问题与 JET 微调法：截断训练轨迹到信息刚够用的那一步、插入解释为什么现在能答的 rationale 并对该 rationale 加权重。摘要给出两个场景的量化结果（自生成轨迹上工具调用减少 11-33%、专家轨迹上比 SFT 少 18-28% 且保留大部分增益），并明确'分数大体保持'。方向与 2611.22901（anytime 停止）重叠，而后者在 anytime 评测与预注册上做得更严谨，且今天的深挖名额不应重复给同一主题。证据细节不足：未给出完整基线表、所用基准名称、两个 8B 模型的评测协议，未找到仓库。

papers.title: FIRE-Drive: Feasibility-Informed Risk Evaluation for End-to-End Diffusion Planning
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based end-to-end autonomous driving models have shown strong potential in generating multimodal planning trajectories. However, their performance still depends heavily on trajectory initialization, mode evaluation, and supervision quality. Weakly constrained noisy initialization may introduce infeasible proposals and increase the burden of denoising. Moreover, selecting the optimal mode remains challenging when candidate trajectories are geometrically similar but differ in safety, interaction risk, and progress. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-Drive, a feasibility-informed risk evaluation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving. FIRE-Drive improves diffusion-based planning through dynamic feasible anchor initialization, candidate-specific bird's-eye-view risk evidence, and compact high-quality candidate supervision with lightweight refinement. This design aligns the initial support, risk-aware scoring, and multimodal supervision of trajectory modes under a unified planning objective. It enables the diffusion decoder to focus on refining plausible trajectories while the scorer distinguishes modes using local risk evidence. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 show that FIRE-Drive achieves a Predictive Driver Model Score of 91.5 with a ResNet34 backbone. Additional closed-loop evaluation on 220 Bench2Drive routes yields a Driving Score of 71.43 and a Success Rate of 42.73%. Component ablations and a scorer comparison under matched candidate inputs support the contributions of feasible initialization, auxiliary supervision, and risk-informed selection. Our code is available at https://github.com/Latte00/FIRE-drive.
papers.llm_reason: 扩散式端到端自动驾驶规划：动态可行锚点初始化 + 候选相关的 BEV 风险证据 + 紧凑候选监督，NAVSIM v1 上 PDM Score 91.5（ResNet34），220 条 Bench2Drive 闭环路线上 Driving Score 71.43、Success Rate 42.73%，有组件消融。数字具体、代码仓库 Latte00/FIRE-drive 实测 HTTP 200 可达且与摘要一致——这是今天少数几个仓库声明能被直接坐实的。但方向是自动驾驶端到端规划，与我们的 agent 工程实践无交集，投入产出不匹配，故列为忽略而非低分否定其质量。
